data.one_liner: Aggregates web search results from multiple search engines including DuckDuckGo, Google, and Bing.
data.what_it_does: A professional metasearch library that queries multiple search engines and provides text, image, video, and news search capabilities. It supports result caching, rate limiting, proxy configuration, and includes a command-line interface.
use_when: You need to fetch search results programmatically from engines like DuckDuckGo, Google, or Bing
You require features like result caching, rate limiting, and proxy support for search queries
avoid_when: You are looking for an official API client for a single search engine's paid web-search developer service
You need high-volume automated scraping where search engines might apply strict anti-bot measures
strengths: Supports multiple search engines and specialized search types (text, images, videos, news)
Includes built-in result caching, rate limiting, and proxy support
Provides both a Dart library API and a command-line interface
weaknesses: Search engines may implement anti-scraping measures causing potential flakiness
Relying on web scraping can break if search engine HTML structures change

alternatives.name: http
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer building custom HTTP requests and parsing search pages manually instead of using a dedicated metasearch library.

alternatives.name: dio
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need a robust HTTP client with advanced interceptors and global configuration for handling web requests.
